title: Fold
description: Fly a paper plane through a house that never ends. Swipe to refold it: the dart dives fast and low, the glider floats across stairwells, and the crane flaps up past bookshelves. Dodge the fans, the lamps and the kettle steam, and see how far you get.

achievements.title: Origami
achievements.description: Fly as the dart, the glider and the crane in one run.

achievements.title: Over the Edge
achievements.description: Glide across 5 stairwells in one run.
